summary: Game crashes after creating/entering a Debug Type world
description: The game crashed whilst ticking player 1.16.2-pre2: [^crash-2020-08-05_11.26.54-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.IllegalStateException: Unregistered biome at bw.b(SourceFile:88) at bw$$Lambda$4540/1295484091.get(Unknown Source) at java.util.Optional.orElseThrow(Optional.java:290) at bw.a(SourceFile:88) at bw.a(SourceFile:68) at bx$a.a(SourceFile:55) at bx.a(SourceFile:31) at bx$$Lambda$4537/457642732.test(Unknown Source) at ck.a(SourceFile:62) at bx.a(SourceFile:31) at aah.v_(SourceFile:484) at aay.b(SourceFile:207) at nd.a(SourceFile:234) at aax.c(SourceFile:173) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:881) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:810) at emy.a(SourceFile:92) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.w(SourceFile:669) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:254) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer$$Lambda$4097/78048568.run(Unknown Source) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.16.2-pre2.
2. Create a new Debug Type world with default settings.
3. Attempt to enter the newly created Debug Type world.
4. Observe that the game crashes while ticking the player.
5. Note any error messages or crash logs generated during the crash.
6. Exit the game and gather the `debug` folder and `crash-reports/*.txt` file for further analysis.
7. Attempt to reproduce the issue by reloading the world and entering it again.
8. Observe that the game crashes in the same manner as before, providing additional evidence of the bug.
Observed Behavior:
When creating or entering a Debug Type world in Minecraft version 1.16.2-pre2, the game crashes while ticking the player. The crash report indicates an `IllegalStateException` with the message "Unregistered biome" at `bw.b(SourceFile:88)`. This suggests that there is an issue with biome registration or loading when entering a Debug Type world. The stack trace points to several methods within the Minecraft codebase, specifically indicating problems in handling biomes and possibly related to optional biome data retrieval.

The crash consistently occurs after attempting to enter or create a Debug Type world, and it does not seem to depend on any specific player actions beyond simply existing in that type of world. The issue is critical as it prevents players from using the Debug Type world feature at all, leading to an immediate game termination upon entry. To reproduce this bug, launch Minecraft 1.16.2-pre2, create or load a Debug Type world, and observe the crash when attempting to tick the player.

For developers, relevant information includes the crash report file (`crash-2020-08-05_11.26.54-server.txt`) and any available debug logs from the game directory. Screenshots of the affected area and a ZIP archive of the `debug` folder can also provide additional context to help diagnose and resolve this issue.
Expected Behavior: When creating or entering a Debug Type world, the game should not crash. The player should be able to navigate and interact with the world without any issues, including ticking players and loading biomes. The game should remain stable and responsive throughout gameplay.
